title: The Banquet and Gu Ying
summary: Using the Divine Movement Chapter, Lin Dong condenses a Destiny Symbol and becomes a 1st Seal Symbol Master. Lin Zhentian breaks through to Yuan Dan initial, and Lin Xiao has recovered to Heavenly Yuan. The Lei family invites the Lin family and Luo Cheng to a banquet, demands they join a merchant alliance under Lei Bao, and attacks when they refuse; Lei Bao reveals he too is at Yuan Dan initial. Gu Ying, vice-master of the Blood Cloth Sect and a 2nd Seal Symbol Master, joins the Lei side for a share of Ironwood Manor and pins everyone with mental strength. Lin Dong fights him with mental strength. When Gu Ying's Materialized Spirit Needle shatters the ancient wood's barrier, Lin Dong learns the Ancient Swirl Symbol from it, absorbs Gu Ying's Destiny Symbol and strikes him down.
events: Lin Dong becomes a 1st Seal Symbol Master and can steer the Yuan-Shattering Shuttle with his mind.
Lin Zhentian forms a four-star Yuan Dan and explains the Yuan Dan stages.
The Lei family's banquet turns into an ambush; Lei Bao shows Yuan Dan initial.
Gu Ying of the Blood Cloth Sect sides with the Lei family for 60% of Ironwood Manor's income.
Gu Ying's mental pressure pins the Lin side; Lin Dong breaks free and fights him.
Gu Ying uses the Materialized Spirit Needle; Lin Dong blocks with the ancient wood.
The broken wood teaches Lin Dong the Ancient Swirl Symbol, which absorbs Gu Ying's Destiny Symbol.
Lin Dong attacks Gu Ying from behind and Lin Zhentian warns the Lei family.
cultivation: Lin Dong becomes a 1st Seal Symbol Master. Lin Zhentian reaches Yuan Dan initial with a four-star Yuan Dan. Lin Xiao is back at Heavenly Yuan. Lei Bao is at Yuan Dan initial. Gu Ying is a 2nd Seal Symbol Master.
